name: Card battle with intents
oneLiner: A turn-based card battle: draw a fanned hand each turn, drag a card onto a foe (a target arrow follows; keys and taps work too) and pay its cost from a small energy pool; draw and discard piles reshuffle when the draw runs out; every foe shows an intent tag with the real numbers of its next move before it acts, then does exactly that; ward absorbs hits until its owner's next turn, statuses (might, barbs, exposed, sapped, burn) change the numbers live on cards and tags; end the turn and the foes act one by one. Content is plain data (cards, foes, statuses), seeded and frame-stepped, with a bot that plays through the same input path.
fits: deck-building roguelites and run-based card games
RPG battles where actions are cards drawn from a deck
puzzle-like boss fights where the player reads the foe's next move
board or tabletop adaptations with an energy budget per turn
short encounters inside an adventure or map game (one fight per node)
notFor: menu-driven party battles without a deck (use A-01 or A-02)
competitive card games against another player with hidden hands (intents show everything the foe will do)

needs: a deck (list of card ids) and the foes of an encounter (enemy ids), the hero's HP / max HP
card, foe and status tables (built-ins ship; the game adds its own as plain data)
a seed per encounter and a fixed 60 Hz update step
key or pointer input routed to the battle while it runs
a place to go when the fight ends (win / lose) and, optionally, a reward screen
provides: the rules: energy, draw / discard / faded piles with seeded reshuffle, ward, damage formula, statuses, foe intents rolled once and acted unchanged
the screen: fanned hand with lift, drag and target arrow, painted foes, intent tags, plates, hero panel with Lumen pips, piles, end-turn button, banners, effects, hit numbers
hit site onHit per HP change on its impact frame (read-only), events intent / act / play / draw / reshuffle / death / end, onTurn, onEnd(result, info)
a bot (search over this turn's plays) that lifts, aims and plays through the player's own input path
unit anchors (live), unit rects (sprite + plate with id), UI rects, card rects, card frame drawing for reward screens

assets: module/card-battle.js (global GameDNA_CardBattle, no dependencies; API in module/README.md). Built-in procedural HD foes (toad, wisp, brute, imp, thief, golem, slime, bat), hero portrait, card frames with code-drawn art glyphs, intent and status glyphs, effects. The starter adds procedural road backdrops (src/art.js). Optional: L-07 card-art pack illustrations through drawArt (demo ?art=pack). No external files required.
